title: VERITAS: Verifier-Guided Proof Search for Zero-Shot Formal Theorem Proving
abstract: arXiv:2606.19399v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM-based formal provers often collapse the verifier's output into a pass/fail bit. We present VERITAS, a zero-shot framework that feeds what Lean reports (error messages with their position, verified partial proofs, and remaining goals) back into proof search. Phase 1 samples N whole proofs; Phase 2 searches a tree of verified partial proofs with a Tactician, automated step repair, a Critic that ranks states and allocates the budget, and a Retriever. On miniF2F test, VERITAS solves 86.9% with Claude Haiku 5.5 and 82.8% with GPT-6 Luna, against 71.7% and 61.1% for Best-of-5 sampling, and solves more theorems than three re-implemented feedback baselines at a third to a half of their search cost. We also evaluate on 55 combinatorics problems of CombiBench and release code and run logs at https://github.com/CoderDoge1108/VERITAS.

translated_title: VERITAS：面向零样本形式化定理证明的验证器引导证明搜索
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的形式化证明器通常将验证器的输出压缩成一个通过/失败的比特。我们提出VERITAS，这是一个零样本框架，将Lean所报告的信息（带位置信息的错误消息、已验证的部分证明以及剩余目标）反馈到证明搜索过程中。第一阶段采样N个完整的证明；第二阶段利用Tactician（战术生成器）、自动步骤修复、对状态进行排序并分配搜索预算的Critic（评论家）以及Retriever（检索器）来搜索已验证的部分证明树。在miniF2F测试集上，VERITAS使用Claude Haiku 5.5解决了86.9%的问题，使用GPT-6 Luna解决了82.8%，而Best-of-5采样的成绩分别为71.7%和61.1%；此外，VERITAS仅以反馈基线三分之一到一半的搜索成本，解决了比三个重新实现的反馈基线更多的定理。我们还在CombiBench的55个组合数学问题上进行了评估，并在 https://github.com/CoderDoge1108/VERITAS 发布了代码和运行日志。
tldr: VERITAS提出了一种零样本证明搜索框架，将Lean验证器的完整反馈信息（错误消息、已验证的部分证明和剩余目标）注入两阶段树搜索中，在miniF2F上以仅三分之一到一半的搜索成本实现了86.9%的解决率，显著超越Best-of-5采样和多个反馈基线方法。
en_tdlr: VERITAS is a zero-shot proof-search framework that feeds Lean's full verifier output—error messages, verified partial proofs, and remaining goals—back into a two-phase tree search, achieving 86.9% on miniF2F at a third to half the search cost of feedback baselines.
